_note: Picture looks and word recipes for Story (src/looks.tsx). A project's `look` / `recipe` / `kicker` / `loop` choose them; a theme in py/studio/assemble.py sets the defaults. Research: docs/research/2026-11-08-reel-effects.md. Motion is transform and opacity only.

film.label: Film
film.what: 16 mm grain that moves every frame, a warm light leak that blooms on each cut, a little gate weave and a soft vignette.

punch.label: Punch
punch.what: Hard cuts that punch in and slide from alternating sides, a speed ramp (fast into the shot, then slow) on video, and a paper flash on each caption cut.

split.label: Split
split.what: Shots play in pairs on a split screen (top and bottom on tall canvases, left and right on wide) at slow motion, wiped in, with each half's season from its capture date.

ember.label: Ember
ember.what: Night mood: firelight that flickers from below, sparks drifting up, a deep vignette.

whip.label: Whip
whip.what: Each shot throws the next one in: a fast blurred pan, left, right, up or down.

zoom.label: Zoom through
zoom.what: The camera seems to fly through one shot into the next.

ridge.label: Ridge
ridge.what: The next shot rises from below behind a mountain line, a different ridge each cut.

slats.label: Slats
slats.what: The next shot opens through seven bars, one after another, like a blind.

iris.label: Iris
iris.what: The next shot opens from a circle at the centre of the frame.

jump.label: Jump
jump.what: Hard cuts, and an overlapping jump cut inside each shot: it steps back a moment and punches in.

mono.label: Colour flood
mono.what: Every shot opens in black and white, then the colour floods in.

pulse.label: Pulse
pulse.what: Hard cuts, and the picture leans in on every half second.

mix.label: Mix
mix.what: A different cut every time: whip, ridge, zoom, slats, iris and hard cuts, so the rhythm keeps changing.

spin.label: Spin
spin.what: Each shot twists and spins into the next.

cube.label: Cube
cube.what: The shots are the faces of a box that turns.

glitch.label: Glitch
glitch.what: The colour channels tear apart for a moment on each cut.

burn.label: Film burn
burn.what: A hot orange burn blooms across each cut.

bars.label: Shutter
bars.what: Black bars close like an eyelid and open on the next shot.

window.label: Window
window.what: The next shot starts as a small rounded card and grows to fill the frame.

print.label: Photo dump
print.what: Each shot lands as a tilted print on a growing pile.

steps.label: Stop-motion
steps.what: The picture changes only every fourth frame, like stop-motion.

hold.label: Freeze
hold.what: Each shot stops on a freeze-frame that drains of colour, then a hard cut breaks it.

mirror.label: Mirror
mirror.what: The frame folds onto itself, left against right, then top against bottom. Landscapes only: it folds people in two, so it is never picked at random.

impact.label: Impact
impact.what: Hard cuts that land too close and shake into place.

letters.label: Through the words
letters.what: The reel opens inside the letters of its headline, then flies through them into the picture.

countdown.label: Countdown
countdown.what: A kicker over the headline, then each proof line arrives with a giant outlined number, counting down to 1.

timeline.label: A day
timeline.what: Shots run morning to night; a rail across the frame marks 朝 昼 夕 夜 from each clip's own capture time and darkness.

pov.label: POV
pov.what: The kicker and headline are typed out with a blinking caret, like a note on a phone.

altitude.label: Altitude
altitude.what: The headline is a counter that climbs to the approved altitude line (標高1,444m) while the shot rises.
